name: The Mosquito Coast
description: Allie Fox—a brilliant inventor and stubborn idealist—uproots his family for a dangerous quest through Mexico to flee the U.S. government and find safety.

videos.title: A Theroux Family Affair
videos.overview: Justin Theroux and his uncle, author Paul Theroux, share the family history that inspired the original novel and the captivating series prequel, The Mosquito Coast.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: Light Out
videos.overview: Writer and executive producer of The Mosquito Coast, Neil Cross, discusses the process of taking Paul Theroux’s novel from page to screen.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: foxes and coyotes
videos.overview: Take a deep dive into Episode 2 of The Mosquito Coast, with Executive Producer Neil Cross and director Rupert Wyatt.

videos.title: A Family on the Run
videos.overview: High stakes, complex moralities, and an adventure like no other. Meet the compelling characters of The Mosquito Coast, through the eyes of writer and executive producer Neil Cross, and actors Justin Theroux, Melissa George, Logan Polish, and Gabriel Bateman.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: Everybody Knows This Is Nowhere
videos.overview: Explore the harsh shooting locations for The Mosquito Coast Episode 3, as the series writers and stars take you behind the scenes of the intense production.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: Bus Stop
videos.overview: The creators and cast of The Mosquito Coast, including Justin Theroux, share their insights into the charter’s deeper motivations.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: Elvis, Jesus, Coca-Cola
videos.overview: The executive producer of The Mosquito Coast, Neil Cross, describes how production took a giant twist when COVID hit.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: Calaca
videos.overview: Take a look into Episode 6 of The Mosquito Coast with Executive Producer Neil Cross, director Rupert Wyatt, and stars Justin Theroux and Melissa George, as they discuss Allie and Margot’s complicated relationship.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: The Glass Sandwich
Light Out
videos.overview: When the U.S. government finally tracks them down, the off-the-grid Fox family flees to begin a new life.

videos.title: foxes and coyotes
videos.overview: The Foxes enlist the help of two coyotes who promise to take them across the U.S. border into Mexico.

videos.title: Everybody Knows This Is Nowhere
videos.overview: With the Feds closing in on them, the Foxes and Chuy must cross the desert on foot—and face adversity both natural and man-made.

videos.title: Bus Stop
videos.overview: The Foxes seek refuge in an opulent hacienda, where a family's all-powerful matriarch sees them as pawns in her own game.

videos.title: Elvis, Jesus, Coca-Cola
videos.overview: Arriving in Mexico City, the Fox parents attempt to connect with Allie's mysterious contact while the kids get into trouble.

videos.title: Calaca
videos.overview: Held captive by a shadowy organization, Allie and Margot must find a way to escape and get back to their kids.

videos.title: The Glass Sandwich
videos.overview: The Foxes are forced into a crisis that will either bring them back together or tear them apart forever.

videos.title: The Damage Done
videos.overview: While venturing deep into the jungle, Allie and Margot reveal the truth about how they became fugitives from the U.S. government.

videos.title: Least Concern Species
videos.overview: After a storm capsizes their boat, the Foxes work to repair it so they won't be stranded by rising waters in an unforgiving jungle.

videos.title: Talk About the Weather
videos.overview: The Foxes find refuge in an isolated jungle haven, but difficulties integrating with the community leave the family torn about whether to stay.

videos.title: A Rag, a Bone, a Hank of Hair
videos.overview: Margot pursues a course of action that threatens to tear the family apart. Charlie has a dangerous encounter that jeopardizes everyone's safety.

videos.title: Positive, Front-Facing Optics
videos.overview: Allie is forced to complete a dangerous task for Casa Roja's landlord. An unexpected guest throws Margot and the kids' lives into disarray.

videos.title: Goat Head Taco
videos.overview: New revelations about Casa Roja leave Allie trapped working with a local drug lord, forcing Margot to take the family's future into her hands.

videos.title: The Burning of Judas
videos.overview: Allie makes a discovery that could change his family's fortunes forever. Margot gets close to Richard in hopes of earning his trust.

videos.title: Dead Totems
videos.overview: Charlie and Allie trek through the jungle to uncover Guillermo's secret. Margot learns Richard's true intentions at Casa Roja.

videos.title: The Counterfeiters
videos.overview: Allie and Margot forge different paths to secure their family's future. Dina lays low at a luxury resort and considers a path of her own.

videos.title: Eulogy
videos.overview: The Foxes reunite to determine the family's future when an unexpected crisis threatens to end their journey once and for all.
